seoTitle: Free Macro Calculator: Carbs, Protein and Fat in Grams
metaDescription: Turn a daily calorie target into grams of carbohydrate, protein and fat using preset splits such as balanced, low-carb or keto. Free and in your browser.
intro: Enter a daily calorie target and pick a carbohydrate, protein and fat split. The tool converts each share into grams per day.
why: Calorie targets are only half of a nutrition plan; many people also want to know how much carbohydrate, protein and fat that adds up to. The conversion is simple but fiddly: carbohydrate and protein give about 4 kcal per gram, fat about 9, so the same percentage means very different gram amounts. This calculator takes your calorie number, applies one of five common presets, from balanced 40/30/30 to keto 5/25/70, and returns the grams for each. It is a handy second step after estimating your calories with the BMR and TDEE tool. It does not tailor the split to your health, so for medical conditions or a competitive sport, ask a dietitian. This is not medical advice.
howTo: Select a split: balanced, low-carb, high-protein, keto or high-carb.
Read the grams of carbs, protein and fat per day.

faq.q: How are grams calculated from percentages?
faq.a: Calories for each macro equal total calories times its share. Carbohydrate and protein are divided by 4 kcal per gram, fat by 9 kcal per gram.

faq.q: Can I set my own percentages?
faq.a: No, the tool offers five fixed presets. If you want a custom split, use the percentage calculator on the calories and divide by 4 or 9.
There is no single best split. It depends on goals, preferences, activity and health. The presets are common starting points, not recommendations.

faq.q: Does it count fibre or alcohol?
faq.a: No. Only carbohydrate, protein and fat are modelled. Alcohol provides around 7 kcal per gram and is not included.
